quotes.text: Our first time on jet skis ever and Six Fins made it feel completely safe and incredibly fun. Manny explained everything clearly at the dock, rode alongside us the whole time, and pointed out landmarks we would have completely missed on our own. The 90 minutes went by in about ten. We’re already planning a return trip.

Captain Dustin took our family out for a snorkeling trip and it was the highlight of our whole vacation. He knew exactly where the healthy reef was and guided our kids the whole time in the water. Small group, private boat, and he was so patient with our youngest who was a little nervous. Six Fins is the real deal.

Rented the private boat charter through Six Fins for our bachelor party — seven guys, Captain Patrick, and a cooler. He found us a sandbar nobody was using, kept the vibe relaxed, and knew exactly when to give us space and when to add some commentary. Zero complaints from anyone in the group. Legendary morning.

Drew was our guide for the freestyle hour and we had an absolute blast. He knows the channels cold and let us really open up the WaveRunners in the safe spots. Easy booking process, professional setup, and we were on the water in minutes. Perfect for a quick hit of adrenaline between other Key West stops.

Captain Dustin timed the sunset perfectly — I don’t know if that’s skill or luck but we were anchored at exactly the right spot as it dropped. Our group of eight had the whole boat to ourselves. He was easygoing, knowledgeable about the reefs and the area, and never made us feel rushed. Stunning evening.

We booked the sandbar charter for our anniversary and Captain Patrick made it feel like it was designed specifically for us. Crystal water, no crowds, Captain knew exactly where to anchor. The shuttle from our hotel was included and the whole experience was seamless. Five stars doesn’t do it justice.
